Shazam Skill v0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Registers the "Shazam" skill for organizing public music platform information, membership details, content links, and copyright info.
- Focuses on official homepage, membership/subscription info, charts, playlists, and help/documentation pages.
- Excludes features like account sharing, bypassing copyright, API access, private data, or non-public content.
- Provides workflows for summarizing member benefits, collating chart/playlist/podcast links, and extracting copyright/user support information.
- Includes guidelines for handling region-based copyright differences and emphasizes output of publicly visible, compliant information only.
